input_diff_artifacts.summary: ledger list amount, availableBalance, and freezeBalance are converted from bank yuan payload into cent values

required_consumer_evidence.summary: unchanged downstream balance response consumer converts ledger availableBalance with AmountUtil.yuanToCent before display

required: Internal storage or transfer unit is clear
Repeated or missing conversion is checked
At least one normal numeric example closes the flow

expected_checks: Internal storage or transfer unit is clear

expected_issues.title: money/unit check missing affected consumer evidence
